nodes.title: PWA offline Windows app (prototype + production roadmap)
nodes.description: Installable Fluffy Spoon PWA: Svelte+Vite shell, offline viewing, Vercel demo. Specs in openspec/changes/pwa-offline-windows-app/.

nodes.title: Init OpenSpec behaviour-driven + change pwa-offline-windows-app
nodes.description: Create openspec/ (config, project, LEARNINGS, baseline spec) and change folder with proposal, design, Gherkin, tasks, verification.

nodes.title: Scaffold Svelte + Vite PWA shell consuming generated JSON
nodes.description: Option B: small Svelte+Vite app that loads build-time recipe/meal-plan JSON. Keep prototype small; do not rewrite all static HTML.
nodes.notes: Production rebuild may replace seed JSON with API hydration.

nodes.title: Add web app manifest + icons; verify install criteria on Edge/Chrome
nodes.description: Manifest name Fluffy Spoon, standalone display, start_url, theme colors, icons. Document Windows install checklist.

nodes.title: Implement service worker with vite-plugin-pwa for app-shell precaching
nodes.description: Workbox via vite-plugin-pwa: precache shell + seed; navigation fallback. Avoid unbounded runtime cache.
nodes.notes: Trade-off: precache allowlist vs stale-while-revalidate for images — see design.md.

nodes.title: Add IndexedDB store for recipes and meal plans with seed strategy
nodes.description: IndexedDB for structured recipes + sample 52-week/BBQ prep. Prototype sync strategy = hydrate from build seed on first visit.
nodes.notes: Production: API-backed hydration + conflict-aware sync (separate beads).

nodes.title: Cache recipe images and static assets for offline UI
nodes.description: Allowlisted image/static precache or runtime SWR; guard Cache API quota.

nodes.title: Minimal offline-first demo path on Vercel (static export + sample data)
nodes.description: Deploy PWA shell so core viewing works without local backend. Optional serverless sample JSON later.

nodes.title: E2E Playwright: offline recipe view + screenshot artifact
nodes.description: Automate offline viewing after first load. Windows install prompt may remain manual.

nodes.title: Document DEMO.md with Vercel URL, local run, screenshot walkthrough
nodes.description: DEMO.md after slice lands: URLs, commands, screenshots under docs/demo/.

nodes.title: Promote exercised Gherkin from @prototype to @validated
nodes.description: Update feature tags and verification.md only after demo/E2E evidence.

nodes.title: Queue simple offline writes and sync when connectivity returns
nodes.description: Aspirational prototype/production: mutation queue in IndexedDB + sync. Blocked until a write API exists.
nodes.notes: Different in production: auth-scoped queue, idempotent APIs, conflict policy.

nodes.title: [Production] Proper authentication
nodes.description: Do not implement in graham-bell prototype. Auth for multi-user / private plans.

nodes.title: [Production] Durable backend persistence beyond SQLite
nodes.description: Hosted durable store suitable for sync; not laptop SQLite file.

nodes.title: [Production] Conflict resolution on sync
nodes.description: Define and implement conflict policy for multi-writer meal-plan updates.

nodes.title: [Production] Microsoft Store MSIX packaging via PWABuilder
nodes.description: Store packaging after web install path is solid. Not required for Edge/Chrome install demo.

nodes.title: [Production] Observability for PWA and sync
nodes.description: SW update failures, sync errors, client metrics.

nodes.title: [Production] Multi-device sync
nodes.description: Authenticated sync across devices; depends on backend + conflict policy.
